title: OnlyFan3
tagline: Onlyfan3 is a decentralized social media that allows creators to share & monetize their content directly with fans. Thanks to web3, users of Onlyfan3 benefit from 1)strong privacy, 2)direct p2p transactions, 3)lower fees, and 4)a healthy ecosystem driven by community governance.
description:
Onlyfan3 is a decentralized application (Dapp) that aims to decentralize the popular social media platform OnlyFans using blockchain technology, specifically a blockchain called FVM. By leveraging blockchain, Onlyfan3 introduces various features and benefits that enhance the user experience and address some of the shortcomings of centralized platforms.

One of the primary features of Onlyfan3 is its ability to allow users to become content creators and earn money instantly by connecting their wallets. This eliminates the need for complicated sign-up processes and allows users to start monetizing their content right away. Additionally, users can subscribe to other creators' accounts and access their private content, further fostering a community of content creators and consumers.

One notable advantage of Onlyfan3 is its low fee structure. Onlyfan3 charges a fee of 6%, which is considerably lower compared to other user-generated-content platforms. Out of this fee, 4% goes to community contributors, who play a role in censoring illegal content, ensuring compliance with regulations. The remaining 2% is allocated to the development costs of the core team that builds and maintains Onlyfan3.

To protect user privacy, Onlyfan3 utilizes a technology called ZK Snark. This technology ensures that subscribers' access and utility are guaranteed without recording their wallet addresses on the blockchain. This feature adds an extra layer of privacy, making the subscription/payment history untraceable and preserving user anonymity.

One critical issue addressed by Onlyfan3 is the censorship of illegal content, such as underage pornography and violence. Traditional centralized platforms often struggle to effectively moderate and censor such content. However, Onlyfan3 tackles this problem by implementing community governance and encouraging community contributors to participate in self-policing based on established protocols.

Wallets that have engaged in monetized content creation or have spent money subscribing to other accounts on Onlyfan3 are immediately eligible to participate in governance. These users can submit proposals to modify or supplement the content censorship rules, ensuring responsible content consumption. They also have the ability to request moderation of problematic content at any time. Moderation requests are aggregated into a dashboard visible to a select group of validators, as defined by the community agreement. Validators can recommend content removal, determine that the content is not problematic, or apply sanctions such as immediate removal or account suspension. In cases where creators are dissatisfied with the moderation decisions, they can request another review by a different moderator, allowing for transparency and accountability in the moderation process. Additionally, contributors who actively participate in governance activities, such as suggesting and voting on content moderation, can earn small amounts of money as a reward.

Overall, Onlyfan3 offers a decentralized alternative to the traditional OnlyFans platform, providing benefits such as instant content monetization, low fees, enhanced privacy, and community-driven content moderation. By leveraging blockchain technology and community governance, Onlyfan3 aims to create a platform that prioritizes user empowerment, responsible content consumption, and user privacy while fostering a thriving ecosystem for content creators and consumers.
how_its_made: Web3.storage was used for image storage, utilizing the storage of Filecoin. The main database used was Polybase, and overall file management, account management, and subscription management were implemented on Polybase. There was an issue with unwanted information being disclosed when using existing smart contracts, but this could be eliminated by using zkproof. Also, the plan was to implement using the reserve contract through FEVM to utilize Filecoin as the main coin. And through Spheron, it was possible to deploy the necessary clients and servers. In near future, we will add streaming service with huddle01 or livepeer. Also, we will add chat feature with libp2p library. At finally we can add persist storage option with lighthouse storage.
